_comment: Tier-2: IGA requires a NURBS geometry definition — control points, knot vectors, weights. Pitfall (kratos.iga #1). NOTE ON THE WRITTEN SIGNAL: this claim carries one of the five shared boilerplate Signal suffixes used across the Kratos catalog, which does not describe what actually happens. The real signal is recorded below and in the fixture output. Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). The NURBS geometry classes NurbsSurfaceGeometry3D and NurbsCurveGeometry3D resolve on core KratosMultiphysics and NOT on IgaApplication, which is the module the claim's context points at. So the geometry a reader must build to use IGA at all is not found where the application name suggests, and the AttributeError fires long before any convergence behaviour. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
